title: Evaluation of a gate shape
statement: Given Boolean values on the nodes in a type $D$, the value of a wire is the value at its node, the value of a negation is one minus the value at its node, and the value of a conjunction is the product of the values at the nodes in its list.
hypotheses_covered: A valuation assigns a Boolean value to every node in D
